question: 79(7)/(40) is equivalent to:
solution:
**Given:**

dfrac{79(7)}{40} is equivalent to:

**Formula used:**

Simple Division

**Calculations:**

79(7)/(40)

**⇒ (**79 × 40) + 7 / 40 

⇒ (3160 + 7) /40 

⇒ 3167 / 40 

**⇒ 79.175**
